name: Floor Lever
summary: Floor-mounted lever or switch handle with a round knob that can be pulled over; for control and machine scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the base plate sits on y

params.name: s
params.note: hero scale: about 420 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.3–0.4 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: pull = the lever swings over to the left and back

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the lever then leans left and pulls to the right)

author: krakujs
